newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices fall on limited interest.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices fall on limited interest.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on low consumer demand and limited enquiries, dealers said.
"Until now mill owners were witnessing higher outstation demand but today outstation buying eased and millers have begun offering more sugar in the local market," one dealer said.

In ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 10 rupees to 1,245/1,275 rupees per quintal while M-30 slid by five rupees to 1,265/1,325 rupees. Sugar mill delivery also moved down by 10 rupees to 1,180/1,190 rupees.
